card.architecture: HiDream-I1 17B MoE DiT (quad encoder), guidance-distilled Dev
card.summary: The Dev (faster, guidance-distilled) HiDream-I1 variant. Same 17B quad-encoder model as Full but ~28 steps at cfg 1 — strong adherence, much quicker, no negative prompt.
use_cases: complex prompts without the Full step count
card.pick_when: You want HiDream's prompt adherence faster than Full and don't need a negative prompt.

prompt.guidance: Detailed natural-language prose; distilled (cfg 1, no negative).
prompt.example: A neon-soaked alley in the rain, a cat in a tiny raincoat under an awning, reflections, cinematic, highly detailed
prompt.instructions: Write rich natural language. Dev is guidance-distilled: ~28 steps, cfg 1, lcm/normal, flow-shift 6. Negative prompts have no effect.
dont: Supply a negative prompt (no effect at cfg 1)

speed.measured_note: 17B MoE Q5_K_M, ~28 steps; not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in detail. Follows instructions closely; faster than Full.
